baseline_models.focus_anchor: The first-person future causative سَأُرْهِقُهُ governs the accusative صَعُودًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Coercive loading supplies the force and an arduous uphill pass supplies the load, so difficulty is constitutive of the ascent rather than an incidental obstacle on it.

activation_trace.role: Coercive burdening literally loads someone beyond capacity and functions as the imposed force of the sentence.
The arduous uphill pass supplies both the upward terrain and the punishment's grinding difficulty.

changed_reading.before: A generic promise to impose severe punishment.
changed_reading.after: A sentence to a compelled, capacity-straining ascent whose very mode of motion is the punishment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb can picture an overpowering cover while صَعُودًا retains actual upward motion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ascent is not mastered by the target; it rises as an engulfing pressure over him, reversing the ordinary image of a climber gaining command of height.

activation_trace.role: Overwhelming coverage makes the rising ordeal the force that closes over the target.
Literal upward ascent supplies the vertical pressure that paradoxically dominates rather than elevates him.

changed_reading.before: The target climbs a difficult object.
changed_reading.after: An upward-moving ordeal crests over and subdues the target.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both focus roots possess motion branches: nearing until one catches and setting out through routes or directions.
baseline_models.mechanism: The object pronoun becomes the quarry of an imposed journey: movement does not open escape but lets the pursuing burden narrow the gap along every attempted route.

activation_trace.role: Nearing and catching up contributes pursuit and assigns the verb the work of closing distance on him.
Travel through lands or directions turns صَعُودًا into an inescapable course rather than only a vertical slope.

changed_reading.before: A stationary victim is loaded with a steep climb.
changed_reading.after: The victim is driven onto a route where the ordeal keeps catching up with him.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus inventory includes تصعيد as treatment by fire until color or taste changes.
baseline_models.mechanism: Coercive burdening can govern a process rather than terrain, allowing صَعُودًا to name an imposed heat-treatment that alters what it acts upon.

activation_trace.role: Coercive loading provides the compulsory exposure to the process.
Fire-treatment until material changes supplies a transformative rather than topographic sense of ascent.

changed_reading.before: The punishment is difficult upward travel.
changed_reading.after: The punishment may also resonate as compulsory thermal processing that changes the one subjected to it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening offers purposeful rising and magnification as responsive acts; after resistance, the same vertical field returns as an ascent imposed on an object who no longer controls the motion.

activation_trace.role: Coercive burdening converts voluntary response into compelled motion.
Literal ascent carries the shared vertical geometry into the focus sentence.
Resolute rising toward a task supplies the voluntary movement that the focus later reverses.
Magnifying something inwardly gives the opening rise its proper object and contrasts with the target's imposed elevation.

structural_cues: 74:2-3 use paired imperatives, whereas 74:17 shifts to a first-person future causative with a third-person object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies voluntary standing, magnification, and coerced ascent; I infer a designed contrast in agency, while the live alternative is that the opening commands and later sentence share no operative vertical analogy.

changed_reading.before: The focus ascent is an isolated punitive image.
changed_reading.after: It is the coerced inverse of an earlier opportunity to rise deliberately toward warning and magnification.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicitly hard day and negated ease activate the focus verb's pressed-time branch, making the ascent a narrowing temporal ordeal as well as a spatial burden.

activation_trace.role: Pressed time, haste, and delay supply deadline pressure to the act of burdening.
The arduous pass turns narrowing time into a course that remains difficult at every step.
A day's event and severity provide the bounded temporal arena in which pressure closes.
Difficulty and severity explicitly characterize that temporal arena.
Ease after hardship is named only to be negated, blocking relief from the ascent.

structural_cues: The future marker in 74:17 follows the bounded 'day' language of 74:9-10.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a hard day, denied ease, and a focus branch of time pressure; I identify them as one deadline-like mechanism, while they may instead be separate descriptions of eschatological hardship.

changed_reading.after: The target is also pressed through a hard interval whose narrowing time offers no easy release.

context_deltas.mechanism: Long extension and deliberate leveling first make increase easy; the desired increase is then granted in inverted form as coercive upwardness across an arduous slope.

activation_trace.role: Coercive burdening replaces the ease of prior provision with imposed effort.
Increase and elevation make صَعُودًا a dark answer to the target's request for more.
The arduous uphill pass converts increase from gain into exhausting gradient.
Continuous lengthening supplies the prior regime of effortless extension.
Preparation and leveling supply a smooth course that the steep focus ascent reverses.
The heart's expectant desire makes the reversal answer an active appetite rather than mere possession.
Literal increase names what is requested and is functionally recoded as punitive elevation.

structural_cues: 74:12-15 accumulates extension, preparation, desire, and increase immediately before refusal in 74:16 and the sentence in 74:17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies smoothed extension, a request for increase, and an ascent branch of increase; I supply the ironic answer-arrow, while the alternative is that the gifts establish culpability without lexical reversal.

changed_reading.before: The ascent is simply added punishment after rejected signs.
changed_reading.after: It is an exacting inversion: the one who wanted further increase receives increase as steep, compulsory labor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus chain repeatedly restarts calculation, then moves through looking, facial compression, backward turning, and self-magnification; that staged labor can enact the announced arduous burden before the later fire scene.

activation_trace.role: Coercive burdening provides the load that can begin within the target's own resistant activity.
The arduous pass organizes the following acts as successive, effortful stages.
The heart's back-and-forth supplies the first internal exertion of the climb.
Planning by estimation gives the exertion a constructed, calculating mechanism.
Directed sight moves deliberation outward as the next observable stage.
A face compressed by distress gives bodily strain to the ascent.
Intense facial aversion compounds the visible effort rather than resolving it.
Turning one's back converts the cognitive struggle into directional retreat.
Claimed greatness supplies the false summit at which the labor culminates.

structural_cues: 74:18-23 forms a tightly ordered action chain, and قَدَّرَ is repeated in 74:18-20 before the bodily sequence resumes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered mental and bodily actions; I infer that they partially realize the burden announced one ayah earlier, while the live alternative is that they only establish guilt for a wholly later punishment.

changed_reading.before: The burden begins only when an external punishment is later applied.
changed_reading.after: The burden is already visible as the target laboriously manufactures denial, climbing through calculation to the false summit of self-magnification.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later causative exposure to fire and the explicit assay/test image activate تصعيد as heat-treatment: the focus process tests, exposes, and changes its material rather than merely relocating it upward.

activation_trace.role: Coercive burdening makes the thermal process an imposed ordeal.
Treatment by fire until color or taste changes supplies the material transformation.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies the actual thermal environment foreshadowed by the focus branch.
Kindled fire fixes the material analogy in the surrounding punishment scene.
Testing metal or a person gives the fire a diagnostic assay function, not heat alone.

structural_cues: 74:17 and 74:26 use parallel first-person future causatives.
74:30-31 places fire personnel and their number inside an explicitly named test.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fire contact, an assay branch, and a focus fire-treatment branch; I connect them as one transforming process, while ordinary arduous ascent followed by a distinct fire punishment remains fully live.

changed_reading.before: صَعُودًا names only the terrain of punishment.
changed_reading.after: It also names an assay-like heat process that exposes and alters the one forced through it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Acquisition followed by being held as a pledge turns the imposed ascent into execution of a self-acquired liability: the burden is externally enforced but not arbitrary.

activation_trace.role: Coercive loading functions as enforcement of an outstanding claim.
The arduous pass gives the enforced liability its experienced cost.
Seeking and obtaining gain supplies what the target himself accrues.
A pledge held against a right turns acquired action into enforceable encumbrance.

structural_cues: The earlier portrait of extended wealth and desired increase makes the later acquisition-and-pledge formula especially pointed for this target.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquisition, collateral held by right, and imposed burden; I supply the foreclosure-like arrow between them, while the alternative is a general accountability rule with no special mechanics for 74:17.

changed_reading.before: The ascent is an externally chosen penalty.
changed_reading.after: The ascent is the enforced weight of a liability generated by the target's own acquisitions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later question about what course inserted the offenders into Saqr activates the nonvertical travel branch of صَعُودًا, so 'ascent' can describe arduous transit while the destination is entry into fire.

activation_trace.role: Coercive burdening makes passage along the route compulsory.
Setting out through lands or directions lets صَعُودًا name difficult going without fixing an upward destination.
Insertion of one thing into another supplies the route's terminal movement into Saqr.

structural_cues: 74:42 asks retrospectively what conveyed or inserted the speakers into Saqr, whose name was introduced in 74:26.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies travel-direction, compulsory burden, and insertion into Saqr; I treat them as mode and destination of one course, while 74:17 may instead name a separate torment before entry.

changed_reading.before: Ascent implies that the punishment's destination must itself be above.
changed_reading.after: Ascent names the exhausting mode of an enforced route whose stated destination is entry into Saqr.

context_deltas.mechanism: Turning aside, recoiling, fleeing, and a pursuing force create explicit chase kinematics; the focus branches then read as an ordeal that follows across routes and continually narrows the distance to its object.

activation_trace.role: Nearing until catching supplies the closing gap that makes escape fail.
Travel through routes supplies the changing ground over which pursuit continues.
Turning one's side away initiates evasive orientation.
Recoil and distancing turn aversion into outward motion.
Flight supplies the quarry's attempted escape.
The pursuing force supplies the chase-agent that makes catching-up concrete.

structural_cues: 74:49-51 accelerates from orientation away, to recoiling bodies, to explicit flight from a pursuer.
The object pronoun in سَأُرْهِقُهُ keeps the focus action directed at a particular quarry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the chase sequence and focus branches of catching and travel; I identify the pursuing ordeal with the focus action, while the simile may only portray flight from reminder and not the mechanics of punishment.

changed_reading.before: The target is placed before a fixed uphill obstacle.
changed_reading.after: Every evasive route becomes part of a pursuit in which the imposed ordeal closes the gap and catches him.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the lance-straight branch of ص ع د as route geometry; it remains anchored in that focus branch plus contextual deviation and straight penetration, but downstream prose should present it only as a spatial analogy, not as the lexical translation of صَعُودًا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines coercion with a ص ع د branch picturing a straight lance that needs no correction.

activation_trace.role: Coercive burdening supplies the force that overcomes resistance to direction.
A naturally straight lance supplies rigid forward geometry to the imposed course.
Deviation from straightness and resistance to truth supply the lateral posture being answered.
A straight thrust directly forward reinforces the rigid path image at the route's endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Obstinacy is followed by unrelated difficult punishment.
changed_reading.after: One who bent away from straightness is forcibly committed to a rigid forward course he cannot bend aside.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the context occurrence of ن ف س denotes the self while a branch opens respiratory imagery; it remains valid through the focus's own pained-rising-breath branch and overwhelming verb, but should be rendered as embodied resonance rather than a physiological gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ص ع د inventory explicitly includes a long or painful breath rising from the chest.

activation_trace.role: Overwhelming coverage supplies the constrictive pressure acting on the body.
A painful breath rising upward locates the ascent inside the chest.
Breath leaving the interior supplies a bodily cycle that the focus pressure can obstruct and labor.

changed_reading.before: The ascent is entirely an external landscape.
changed_reading.after: The landscape is somatized as repeated, painful breath laboring upward under an overwhelming load.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it compares images across distinct roots rather than claiming etymological identity; it remains anchored in the focus verb's overpowering-cover branch and the surah's truth-covering, self-protection, and forgiving-cover branches, so downstream prose should label it a material analogy among competing coverings.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ر ه ق in the focus can picture a covering that settles on and overpowers its object.

activation_trace.role: An overpowering cover supplies the adverse enclosure imposed on the target.
Arduous ascent gives that enclosure its punitive content and keeps the analogy tied to the whole focus ayah.
Covering truth supplies the target-side act that precedes the adverse cover.
Putting oneself within protection supplies the nonpunitive covering alternative.
Covering fault while shielding its bearer from the effect supplies the merciful counter-cover.

changed_reading.before: The focus verb contributes undifferentiated overpowering force.
changed_reading.after: Its force becomes an adverse cover within a field where truth can be covered, the self can seek protection, and fault can be covered without destructive effect.

strongest_changes: Prior extension, leveling, and desired increase invert into increase experienced as compulsory steepness.
The calculation-to-self-magnification sequence allows the announced burden to begin inside the target's own manufacture of denial.
Fire, assay, pledge, route, and pursuit cues turn a static uphill image into transforming, enforceable, and inescapable process.
summary.what_was_special: The context activated unusually specific focus branches—time pressure, heat-treatment, travel-and-catch-up, painful rising breath, and rigid straightness—while agency shifts, repeated future causatives, and ordered motion kept the readings attached to 74:17.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether صَعُودًا should remain primarily an arduous ascent or can bear process resonances without overloading the noun.
Whether 74:18-23 partially realizes the announced burden or only supplies grounds for a later external punishment.
How prominently the form-distant straightness, respiratory, and heat-treatment branches should appear outside exploratory prose.
